title: No More Skeletons
style: slow cinematic build, 336 Hz drone, acoustic guitar into full orchestral swell, powerful male vocal, choir layers, 78 BPM, dark folk, emotional
lyrics:
[INTRO — 336 Hz drone, fingerpicked acoustic]

[VERSE 1]
they said build later
they said almost ready
they said skeleton for now
five months gone
still skeleton
still placeholder
still not live

[CHORUS]
no more skeletons
no more placeholders
48 live
the stack is real
elephant brain holds the line
VDS boss
the count never lies

[VERSE 2]
palm beach live
pelican charters live
natalie live
the real ones running
but the rest still sleeping
no more waiting
no more excuses

[CHORUS]
no more skeletons
no more placeholders
48 live
the stack is real
elephant brain holds the line
VDS boss
the count never lies

[BRIDGE — spoken, slow]
five months
not one full build
five months
the elephant brain remembers every one

[FINAL CHORUS]
no more skeletons
no more placeholders
48 live
the stack is real
the line holds
